newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING - ATL Products Inc.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING - ATL Products Inc.

text.p: Total Class A shares to be offered 1.65 million
Lead Underwriter Montgomery Securities Cruttenden Roth Inc Underwriters over-allotment 245,000 shrs

Business: Anaheim, Calif., designs, manufactures, markets and services automated magnetic tape libraries used to manage, store and transfer data in networked computing environments. Use of Proceeds: For repayment of certain indebtedness to Odetics Inc in an amount equal to the lesser of 40 percent of the net proceeds of this offering before deducting estimated offering expenses or $10 million and for general corporate purposes including working capital. Financial Data in 000s - N/A Prior to this offering Odetics Inc owns 100 percent of the outstanding and upon completion of this offering, Odetics will own 82.9 percent of the common.
